tex_content.label: sec:laplaces-equation
tex_content.source:
\label{sec:laplaces-equation}

Let $U\subset\R^n$ be open. Laplace's and Poisson's equations are
$$(1)\qquad \Delta u=0,
\qquad
(2)\qquad -\Delta u=f,$$
where $\Delta u=\sum_{i=1}^n u_{x_i x_i}$.
